name: After § 30
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 30a. Expresses serious doubts as to the RRF’s ability to achieve its initial objectives, given the significant disparities in absorption rates and the persistent difficulties in accessing the funds; fears that, far from strengthening sustainability, resilience and preparedness for future challenges, the RRF may in fact exacerbate existing imbalances and divergences between EU Member States, thereby demonstrating that it was poorly conceived and hastily designed;
